iptables-save:
*raw
:PREROUTING ACCEPT [COUNTERS]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [COUNTERS]
COMMIT
*filter
:INPUT ACCEPT [COUNTERS]
:FORWARD DROP [COUNTERS]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [COUNTERS]
:DOCKER - [COUNTERS]
:DOCKER-BRIDGE - [COUNTERS]
:DOCKER-CT - [COUNTERS]
:DOCKER-FORWARD - [COUNTERS]
:DOCKER-INTERNAL - [COUNTERS]
:DOCKER-USER - [COUNTERS]
-A FORWARD -j DOCKER-USER
-A FORWARD -j DOCKER-FORWARD
-A DOCKER ! -i br-170923d8cded -o br-170923d8cded -j DROP
-A DOCKER ! -i docker0 -o docker0 -j DROP
-A DOCKER-BRIDGE -o br-170923d8cded -j DOCKER
-A DOCKER-BRIDGE -o docker0 -j DOCKER
-A DOCKER-CT -o br-170923d8cded -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-A DOCKER-CT -o docker0 -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-A DOCKER-FORWARD -j DOCKER-CT
-A DOCKER-FORWARD -j DOCKER-INTERNAL
-A DOCKER-FORWARD -j DOCKER-BRIDGE
-A DOCKER-FORWARD -i br-170923d8cded -j ACCEPT
-A DOCKER-FORWARD -i docker0 -j ACCEPT
COMMIT
*nat
:PREROUTING ACCEPT [COUNTERS]
:INPUT ACCEPT [COUNTERS]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [COUNTERS]
:POSTROUTING ACCEPT [COUNTERS]
:DOCKER - [COUNTERS]
-A PREROUTING -m addrtype --dst-type LOCAL -j DOCKER
-A OUTPUT ! -d 127.0.0.0/8 -m addrtype --dst-type LOCAL -j DOCKER
-A POSTROUTING -s 172.17.0.0/16 ! -o docker0 -j MASQUERADE
-A POSTROUTING -s 172.18.0.0/16 ! -o br-170923d8cded -j MASQUERADE
COMMIT
ip6tables-save:
*filter
:INPUT ACCEPT [COUNTERS]
:FORWARD ACCEPT [COUNTERS]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [COUNTERS]
:DOCKER - [COUNTERS]
:DOCKER-BRIDGE - [COUNTERS]
:DOCKER-CT - [COUNTERS]
:DOCKER-FORWARD - [COUNTERS]
:DOCKER-INTERNAL - [COUNTERS]
:DOCKER-USER - [COUNTERS]
-A FORWARD -j DOCKER-USER
-A FORWARD -j DOCKER-FORWARD
-A DOCKER-FORWARD -j DOCKER-CT
-A DOCKER-FORWARD -j DOCKER-INTERNAL
-A DOCKER-FORWARD -j DOCKER-BRIDGE
COMMIT
*nat
:PREROUTING ACCEPT [COUNTERS]
:INPUT ACCEPT [COUNTERS]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [COUNTERS]
:POSTROUTING ACCEPT [COUNTERS]
:DOCKER - [COUNTERS]
-A PREROUTING -m addrtype --dst-type LOCAL -j DOCKER
-A OUTPUT ! -d ::1/128 -m addrtype --dst-type LOCAL -j DOCKER
COMMIT
